title: 社会科学 · 7.13 社会创业

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: Listen to a talk on a business podcast.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: You probably know what entrepreneurs are, people who identify a need in the market and create their own businesses.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: Today we are going to focus on people who combine that entrepreneurial spirit with social impact.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: I am talking about social entrepreneurs.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: These are individuals who seek to solve societal problems through innovative and sustainable business solutions.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: Unlike traditional entrepreneurs, their primary goal is not simply to make money; they also strive to create positive change in society.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: One key feature of social entrepreneurship is a focus on addressing gaps in the market that affect underserved communities.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: This can include anything from providing affordable health care and education to developing environmentally friendly technologies.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: Social entrepreneurs often work in sectors where social needs are most pressing, such as poverty, health, and the environment.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: They do this by leveraging business strategies to create scalable and sustainable solutions.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: As you can imagine, social entrepreneurship can be challenging.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: Balancing profitability with social goals can be complex and demanding.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: Measuring the social impact of an initiative is also a difficult undertaking; what exactly should be measured?

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: These ventures often require significant resources and support to get off the ground.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: Despite these obstacles, social entrepreneurship can lead to innovative solutions that traditional businesses might overlook and foster a more inclusive and equitable society.
